description: FR3-04 (ruling FR3-R2): the approval record of a project protocol, <project>/benchmarks/project/protocol/approval.json. An APPROVED protocol loads only when this record names the sha256 of the protocol file bytes and the protocol's approval reference (bench_model.load_protocol); otherwise every plan, run, check and decide of the project is BLOCKED. Tamper-evident, not tamper-proof: the record is unsigned, and review of the protected protocol directory is the control (docs/approval-protocol.md).
